queries: SELECT product_id::String AS product_id, category, subcategory, brand, price_eur, description, created_at, is_active FROM shop.catalog
SELECT * FROM shop.catalog_updates WHERE ts::DateTime64(3) < '2026-11-05 07:00:00.281' ORDER BY ts::DateTime64(3), product_id::String

SELECT request_id::String AS request_id, ts::String AS ts,
            user_id, context, recent_views, shown, propensity, clicked, purchased
            FROM shop.history_sessions WHERE ts::DateTime64(3) >= '2026-09-15 07:00:06.371'
            AND ts::DateTime64(3) < '2026-10-27 07:00:01.356'
            ORDER BY cityHash64(concat(request_id::String, '20261114')), request_id::String LIMIT 20000

SELECT request_id::String AS request_id, ts::String AS ts,
            user_id, context, recent_views, shown, propensity, clicked, purchased
            FROM shop.history_sessions WHERE ts::DateTime64(3) >= '2026-10-27 07:00:01.356'
            AND ts::DateTime64(3) < '2026-11-05 07:00:00.281'
            ORDER BY cityHash64(concat(request_id::String, '20261114')), request_id::String LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts::String AS ts, user_id::String AS user_id,
        product_id::String AS product_id, event_type::String AS event_type, price_eur
        FROM shop.history_events WHERE ts::DateTime64(3) >= '2026-09-15 07:00:06.371' AND ts::DateTime64(3) < '2026-10-27 07:00:01.356'
        ORDER BY cityHash64(concat(user_id::String, session_id::String, product_id::String,
        event_type::String, ts::String, '20261114')), user_id::String, ts::String, product_id::String LIMIT 200000

SELECT product_id::String AS product_id, count() AS n
        FROM shop.history_events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND ts::DateTime64(3) >= '2026-09-15 07:00:06.371'
        AND ts::DateTime64(3) < '2026-10-27 07:00:01.356' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY n DESC, product_id DESC LIMIT 10000
